goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: The interaction contract is sufficiently bounded for one vertical marquee-selection slice. Client-coordinate geometry and direct-child active-scope enumeration address zoom, transforms, and ancestor/descendant normalization without changing SVG data. The existing dirty diff overlaps five allowed files but is unrelated and can be preserved. T003 must retain Space/middle pan, object drag, Alt/double-click replacement, and clean history/serialization. Preferences, pixel-painted clip/mask hit testing, and generalized multi-object transforms remain outside this package.

worker_package.objective: Implement one complete marquee-selection vertical slice: client-coordinate rectangle geometry for containment and touching rules; stage pointer arbitration; direct-child active-scope candidate normalization; replace and Shift-union marquee selection; platform-accelerator exact toggle with cross-scope replacement; defensive cancellation and focus-aware Escape; visible secondary-selection feedback with only the primary receiving handles; and behavioral regression coverage proving pan, object drag, locks, visibility, layer synchronization, history, dirty state, and serialization remain correct.

gesture_precedence: Transform handles and ordinary primary-button object drag retain existing behavior.
Middle-button drag or Space+primary drag pans from any stage location and never starts marquee.
Primary-button drag beginning on a non-selectable stage, artboard, or SVG-root pixel enters pending marquee; this includes surrounding stage padding.
Activate marquee after 4 CSS pixels of movement measured in client coordinates. Before activation, unmodified pointerup performs background-clear; Shift-pointerup is a no-op.

After activation, pointerup commits selection and suppresses the subsequent click. Escape, pointercancel, lostpointercapture, document replacement, or review lock cancels and restores the pre-gesture selection.

Configured exact-modifier primary pointer sequences over selectable objects are selection-only: they must not initiate drag or transform. Commit only below the movement threshold; cancel after movement.
selection_contract: Freeze the active scope at marquee start and enumerate only selectable direct children whose selectable parent equals that scope.
Never select both an ancestor and descendant. Preserve DOM paint order and make the last matched candidate primary.
Unmodified marquee replaces selection; no matches clear selection. Shift-marquee unions matches with the existing same-scope selection; no matches preserve it.
Use getBoundingClientRect for both marquee and candidates. Fully-enclosed uses inclusive rectangle containment; touching support uses inclusive rectangle intersection for later preference wiring.
Use browser client bounds as transformed geometric bounds. Do not attempt pixel-painted clip-path or mask geometry in T003.
visibility_and_lock_contract: Exclude editor handles, roots, resources, nested SVGs, display:none, visibility:hidden/collapse, effectively zero-opacity nodes, and candidates without a usable client rect.
Do not reject a line merely because one client-rect dimension is zero; reject only non-rendered or wholly zero-area candidates.
Locked visible objects remain selectable for inspection, while existing mutation guards must continue preventing movement or transformation.
modifier_contract: Default precise toggle is Meta-click on macOS and Ctrl-click elsewhere, only for an otherwise unmodified primary click.

Within the active scope, exact modifier-click toggles the direct target. Outside that scope, it replaces selection and resets scope to the target's selectable parent; cross-parent additive selection is forbidden.
Alt-click and double-click retain exact replacement/drill-in behavior. Shift-click retains scoped additive behavior.
Do not consume modified combinations such as Cmd/Ctrl+Shift, Cmd/Ctrl+Alt, secondary clicks, or accelerator clicks with no selectable target.
escape_and_focus_contract: Escape always cancels an active marquee.
With no active marquee, Escape clears canvas selection only when no modal is open and focus is not in an editable control or contenteditable region.
